integrity: The proof independently handles the singular case by orthogonal range-kernel decomposition. Only after establishing b in Range(H) is the recent positive-definite phase theorem applied on the effective range space. The dual statement is reconstructed directly from the Lorentz representation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the shifted ellipsoidal SOCP family with symmetric positive-semidefinite H. It does not give a general singular-conic perturbation theory or full-space Hessian conditioning after rank loss.
title: Complete phase diagram for rank-deficient shifted ellipsoidal SOCPs
